cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Lets AI Agents Shop
cards.body: ChatGPT's new Wallet feature enables AI agents to shop and checkout on users' behalf. The feature is rolling out to U.S. Pro subscribers in a limited capacity.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches ElevenAI Meeting App
cards.body: ElevenLabs released ElevenAI, a new meeting notetaker and dictation app for teams and enterprises. The app combines note-taking and voice transcription capabilities.

cards.title: Google Search Gets Gemini 4 Hydrogen
cards.body: Google's latest Search upgrade uses Gemini 4 Hydrogen to better understand complex queries. The update delivers richer visual responses and more relevant search results.

cards.title: Nectar AI Agent Automates Influencer Marketing
cards.body: Nectar launched an AI agent that automates creator discovery and brand outreach. The tool helps manage partnerships and track campaign performance.

cards.title: Muse AI Can Now Call Businesses
cards.body: Muse's AI now places outbound calls to U.S. businesses with a paid service model. The capability expands the platform's business automation features.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion AI Expansion
cards.body: Nebius announced $40 billion in planned spending for AI infrastructure expansion. The company plans to fund growth through customer prepayments and loans.

cards.title: Phota Labs Automates Professional Photo Editing
cards.body: Phota Labs uses AI to automatically enhance everyday photos to professional quality. The tool simplifies the editing process for non-technical users.

cards.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Booking Agents
cards.body: United Airlines will not allow customers to use AI agents for flight bookings. The airline cited cybersecurity risks as the reason for the restriction.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns From Nvidia
cards.body: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO following scandal reports. CFO Colette Kress is taking over as interim replacement.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Raises Open Source Questions
cards.body: Huang's resignation puts Nvidia's open-source AI commitments in question. The departure raises concerns about the company's $12.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition.

cards.title: Hugging Face Pledges Open Source Commitment
cards.body: Hugging Face CEO vowed to continue fighting for open-source AI after Huang's departure. The commitment reflects concerns about Nvidia's future direction.

cards.title: Congressional Democrats Investigate Nvidia
cards.body: Democrats launched a second investigation into Nvidia over China sales and Trump dealings. The inquiry follows reports of Huang's alleged spy affair.

cards.title: Huang Agrees To Testify Before Congress
cards.body: Jensen Huang agreed to testify before Congress after lawmakers threatened subpoenas. The hearing follows his ouster as Nvidia CEO.

cards.title: Trump Suggests Tim Cook For Nvidia
cards.body: President Trump floated Apple chairman Tim Cook as Huang's successor at Nvidia. Trump posted the suggestion on Truth Social.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Could Damage AI Industry
cards.body: Huang's departure threatens to undermine specific industry directions he championed. His influence shaped key AI development trajectories.

cards.title: SoftBank Loses $3B on Power Infrastructure
cards.body: SoftBank lost over $3 billion preordering natural gas turbines for AI data centers. The loss signals potential limits to AI's energy expansion plans.

cards.title: Israel VCs See Nvidia Opportunity Emerging
cards.body: Israeli startup investors see opportunities amid Nvidia's leadership turmoil. The country's tech ecosystem is concerned about the company's strategic direction.

cards.title: Huang Showed Doubt In New Leadership
cards.body: Huang described his successor Colette Kress as a 'deer in the headlights' during a meeting. The comment suggests limited confidence in the transition.

cards.title: Reports Link Huang To Multiple Affairs
cards.body: Reuters reported Jensen Huang was having a third affair with an Nvidia employee. The report withheld the employee's identity.

cards.title: OpenAI Board Member Warns of AI Takeover Risk
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concern that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning highlights escalating fears about rapid AI advancement and its societal implications.

cards.title: FAA Expands AI for US Air Traffic Management
cards.body: The FAA is rolling out AI solutions to manage air traffic congestion across the entire US airspace. This marks a significant step in automating critical aviation infrastructure.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model
cards.body: Google has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing the 3.8 Flash version. The upgrade represents progress in the company's AI model evolution.

cards.title: Schools Call for AI Moratorium After Gemini Backlash
cards.body: Google faces mounting calls for AI moratoriums in schools following backlash from its Gemini pilot program. Educators are raising concerns about classroom deployment of AI tools.

cards.title: Google Launches Gemini Smartglasses at $395
cards.body: Google is debuting new Gemini-powered smartglasses starting at $395, emphasizing privacy features. The device integrates AI directly into wearable technology.

cards.title: Elder Scrolls Game Gets AI-Coded Glow-Up
cards.body: Shadowkey, The Elder Scrolls' most obscure adventure, receives a 4K PC makeover with AI-coded enhancements. The project adds new features leveraging artificial intelligence.

cards.title: Sam Altman's Vision Failed on 2024 Midterms
cards.body: Silicon Valley leaders like OpenAI's Sam Altman claimed to foresee the future but got the midterms wrong. The misstep reveals cracks in tech visionaries' predictive capabilities.

cards.title: Nvidia Confirms Chip-Tracking Tech Feasibility
cards.body: Nvidia privately confirmed it could technically implement anti-smuggling measures under the Chip Security Act. The capability contradicts industry claims that tracking was infeasible.
